relevance.rationale: This is the paper that proposes the 3d-3d dictionary itself: it constructs the 3d N=2 theory T_M from an ideal triangulation (sec. 4.1), works out the figure-eight case explicitly (sec. 4.6), computes the S_b^3 partition function including for the figure-eight (sec. 6.3), and relates line operators to q-difference equations (sec. 7). conj:stokes-dt-bps-bridge is stated in terms of 'the associated 3d N=2 theory T[K]' and its state integral, and its .md attributes the dictionary to the existing entry dimofte-gaiotto-gukov2013 -- but that entry is the 3d-index sequel; the dictionary and the construction of T[K] are this earlier paper. So the corpus is currently citing the sequel for the predecessor's result, and the object its conjecture names (T[K] and its S_b^3 state integral) is defined here.

keyResults.statement: A 3d N=2 theory T_M is assigned to an ideally-triangulated 3-manifold, with the figure-eight knot complement worked out explicitly; triangulation-independence corresponds to mirror symmetry of the resulting theories.
keyResults.useForFolio: Defines T[K], the object conj:stokes-dt-bps-bridge quantifies over; fixes the attribution of 'the 3d-3d dictionary' that the block currently assigns to the 3d-index paper.

keyResults.statement: The S_b^3 partition function of T_M is assembled from tetrahedron factors and computed for the figure-eight knot.
keyResults.useForFolio: This is the state integral whose resurgent Stokes constants the corpus's bridge conjecture identifies with DT/BPS counts; the corpus currently has no citation for the state integral's construction.

proposedActions.rationale: No ref() entry. Distinct paper from dimofte-gaiotto-gukov2013 (which is the 3d-index sequel).

conj:stokes-dt-bps-bridge's .md says 'the 3d-3d dictionary is [dimofte-gaiotto-gukov2013]'; that entry is the 3d-index paper. The dictionary and the construction of T[K] belong to this one. The attribution should be corrected or split.
